title: Calendar view shows "[object Object]" for every event when titleField is a lookup field
body:
Category: ① defect with reach — any calendar view whose `calendar.titleField` names a lookup (the common case: "who/what is this event about") renders every event as the literal text `[object Object]`.

Who acts: objectui maintainer seat (plugin-calendar `ObjectCalendar`).

Dedupe: searched objectui for "calendar titleField lookup [object Object]" — 10 hits, none on the calendar title (closest closed siblings: objectui#12188 related-list card title, objectui#8464 record summary chips — same `[object Object]` family, different surface).

## Repro

- runtime / console 18.0.0. View metadata:

```ts
calendar: {
  type: 'calendar',
  data: { provider: 'object', object: 'srm_supplier_audit' },
  calendar: { startDateField: 'planned_date', titleField: 'supplier', colorField: 'audit_type' },
}
```

`supplier` is `Field.lookup('srm_supplier')`. Open the calendar tab with a few records in the visible month.

## Actual

Each event chip reads `[object Object]` (the record arrives with the lookup expanded to `{ id, name, … }`).

## Expected

The lookup's display name (the referenced record's name / `displayField`), the same text the grid shows in that column.

## Where

`packages/plugin-calendar/src/ObjectCalendar.tsx`, `resolveTitle`: `const v = record[titleField]; … if (s) return String(s);` — an object value is stringified raw. It should go through the same type-aware display resolution the grid cell / `getRecordDisplayName` use.

## Downstream

objectstack-ai/hotsrm switches its audit calendar to `titleField: 'audit_no'` until this is fixed (the supplier name is lost on the chip).

Filed from Claude session session_01E7UNrUkwEKDrg7BXnKF5LU (hotsrm v0.4 browser acceptance).
